coreAttributes.name: huge portal ring
coreAttributes.description: An enormous ring of arcane alloy, wide enough to encircle a torso or a chest. The inner surface is lined with runes that pulse softly with contained power. When linked to a remote portal, the body section it encircles appears to vanish at this end — the top or bottom half of the torso, or the entire chest — emerging at the remote location. The result is severely restrictive, as the missing section is simply... elsewhere.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(step)] through the huge portal ring. As it activates, a significant portion of [npc.her] body seems to vanish into the shimmering aperture, the effect deeply disorienting.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(guide)] the huge portal ring into position around [npc2.namePos] body. The arcane aperture engulfs the relevant section, which promptly disappears from view.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly [npc.verb(force)] the huge portal ring around [npc2.namePos] body.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(remove)] the huge portal ring. The missing portion of [npc.her] body reappears with a disorienting lurch as the portal collapses.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(slide)] the huge portal ring off [npc2.name], [npc2.her] displaced body section snapping back into existence.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly [npc.verb(yank)] the huge portal ring off [npc2.name].
